# Workshop manuals (text versions)

> Official eLearn workshop manuals for Alfa Romeo, Fiat and Lancia models. Each model has its own text version: plain HTML pages with the path, applicability and links of every topic. Pick the model, then follow its own llms.txt.

## Models
- [Alfa 147 (English)](https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB-a147/en/llms.txt): 3900 topics, 5 engines
- [Alfa 159 (English)](https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/alfa/159/en/llms.txt): 4026 topics, 7 engines
- [Lancia Thesis (English)](https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB-lThss/en/llms.txt): 4944 topics, 6 engines

## Optional
- [Interactive site: choose a model](https://sloeber94.github.io/elrnDB/)
